description: This file provides helper functions to convert difficulty settings into concrete search limits for an AI component in a chess game platform. It defines types, and exports a function `getLimitsForDifficulty` which maps 'easy', 'medium', 'hard', or custom settings into specific maximum depth, time, and hard time limits.

methods.name: getLimitsForDifficulty(difficulty, custom = {})
methods.description: Converts a difficulty level ('easy', 'medium', 'hard') or custom settings into concrete search limit parameters for AI decision-making.
